articles.title_en: Monetary Policy When the Phillips Curve Is Quite Flat
articles.title_cn: 当菲利普斯曲线相当平坦时的货币政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper highlights how the presence of a monetary policy cost channel can offer new insights into the relation between monetary policy and inflation when the Phillips curve is quite flat. For instance, we highlight a key condition whereby lax monetary policy can push the economy to a low-inflation trap, and we discuss how, under the same condition, standard policy rules targeting inflation may need to be modified. In the empirical part of the paper, we explore the relevance of the condition that gives rise to these observations. The results support the key condition we emphasize. (JEL E24, E31, E43, E52)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文着重指出，当菲利普斯曲线相当平坦时，货币政策成本渠道的存在如何为货币政策与通货膨胀之间的关系提供新的见解。例如，我们强调了一个关键条件，在此条件下，宽松的货币政策可能将经济推入低通胀陷阱，并讨论了在同一条件下，针对通胀的标准政策规则可能需要进行修改。在论文的实证部分，我们探讨了引发这些观察的条件的相关性。结果支持我们所强调的关键条件。（JEL E24, E31, E43, E52）

articles.title_cn: 能源供应中的创新驱动转型
articles.abstract_en: Generalizing models of directed technical change, I show that complementarities between innovations and factors of production (here, energy resources) can drive transitions away from a dominant sector. In a calibrated numerical implementation, the economy gradually transitions energy supply from coal to gas and then to renewable energy, even in the absence of policy. The welfare-maximizing tax on carbon emissions is J-shaped, immediately redirects most research to renewables, and rapidly transitions energy supply directly to renewables. The emission tax is twice as valuable as either the welfare-maximizing research subsidy or the welfare-maximizing mandate to use renewable resources. (JEL H23, O31, O33, Q35, Q41, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 通过推广定向技术变革模型，我证明了创新与生产要素（此处为能源资源）之间的互补性可以推动经济从主导部门转型。在一个校准的数值实现中，即使没有政策，经济也会逐渐将能源供应从煤炭转向天然气，再转向可再生能源。福利最大化的碳排放税呈J形，立即将大部分研究转向可再生能源，并迅速将能源供应直接转向可再生能源。排放税的价值是福利最大化的研究补贴或福利最大化的可再生能源使用指令的两倍。（JEL H23, O31, O33, Q35, Q41, Q54）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Extending Employment Protection to Agency Workers on Firms
articles.title_cn: 将就业保护扩展到劳务派遣工人对企业的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of a reform that extended employment protection to temporary agency workers. Using a difference-in-difference research design, we show that plants more exposed to the regulation experienced a decrease in revenues and total employment, and that the latter effect was attenuated in industries with high elasticity of substitution between agency and nonagency workers. We also find that labor misallocation increased as a consequence of the regulation. A model of labor demand in the presence of agency work rationalizes these results. (JEL J22, J23, J31, K31, L60, M51, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项将就业保护扩展到临时劳务派遣工人的改革的影响。采用双重差分研究设计，我们发现受该法规影响更大的工厂经历了收入和总就业的下降，且后者效应在劳务派遣与非派遣工人之间替代弹性高的行业中有所减弱。我们还发现，由于该法规，劳动力错配加剧。一个存在劳务派遣的劳动力需求模型合理化了这些结果。（JEL J22, J23, J31, K31, L60, M51, O15）

articles.title_en: Immigrant Communities and Knowledge Spillovers: Danish Americans and the Development of the Dairy Industry in the United States
articles.title_cn: 移民社区与知识溢出：丹麦裔美国人与美国乳制品业的发展
articles.abstract_en: Despite the growing literature on the impact of immigration, little is known about the role existing migrant settlements can play for knowledge transmission and the location of industry. We present a case that can illustrate this important mechanism and hypothesize that nineteenth-century Danish American communities helped spread knowledge on modern dairying to rural America. From around 1880 Denmark developed rapidly, and by 1890 it was a world-leading dairy producer. Using a difference-in-differences strategy and data taken from the US census and Danish emigration archives, we find that counties with more Danes in 1880 subsequently both specialized in dairying and used more modern practices. (JEL J15, J61, L66, N31, N51, O33, Q12)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管关于移民影响的文献日益增多，但关于现有移民定居点对知识传播和产业区位的作用，我们知之甚少。我们提出了一个案例来说明这一重要机制，并假设19世纪的丹麦裔美国人社区帮助将现代乳制品业知识传播到了美国农村。大约从1880年开始，丹麦迅速发展，到1890年已成为世界领先的乳制品生产国。利用双重差分策略以及来自美国人口普查和丹麦移民档案的数据，我们发现1880年丹麦人较多的县随后在乳制品业上更加专业化，并采用了更多现代做法。（JEL J15, J61, L66, N31, N51, O33, Q12）

articles.title_en: Wage Rigidity and Employment Outcomes: Evidence from Administrative Data
articles.title_cn: 工资刚性与就业结果：来自行政数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between downward nominal wage rigidity and employment outcomes using linked employer-employee data. Wage rigidity prevents 27.1 percent of counterfactual wage cuts, with a standard deviation of 19.2 percent across establishments. An establishment with the sample-average level of wage rigidity is predicted to have a 3.3 percentage point higher layoff rate, a 7.4 percentage point lower quit rate, and a 2.0 percentage point lower hire rate. Estimating a structural model by indirect inference implies that the cost of a nominal wage cut is 33 percent of an average worker’s annual compensation. (JEL E24, J23, J31, J63, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用关联的雇主-雇员数据考察了名义工资下行刚性与就业结果之间的关系。工资刚性阻止了27.1%的反事实工资削减，各机构间的标准差为19.2%。具有样本平均工资刚性水平的机构，其裁员率预计高出3.3个百分点，离职率低7.4个百分点，招聘率低2.0个百分点。通过间接推断估计结构模型，名义工资削减的成本相当于平均工人年度薪酬的33%。（JEL E24, J23, J31, J63, M51）

articles.title_en: Homeownership and Portfolio Choice over the Generations
articles.title_cn: 代际间的住房所有权与投资组合选择
articles.abstract_en: Earnings are riskier and more unequal for households born in the 1960s and 1980s than for those born in the 1940s. Despite improvements in financial conditions, younger generations are less likely to be living in their own homes than older generations at the same age. By using a life cycle model with housing and portfolio choice that includes flexible earnings risk and aggregate asset price risk, I show that changes in earnings dynamics account for a large part of the reduction in homeownership across generations. Lower-income households find it harder to buy housing and, as a result, accumulate less wealth. (JEL D15, G51, J31, R21, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 对于出生于1960年代和1980年代的家庭而言，其收入风险更高且不平等程度更大，相比之下，出生于1940年代的家庭则不然。尽管金融条件有所改善，但年轻一代在相同年龄时拥有自己住房的可能性低于老一代。通过使用包含灵活收入风险和总资产价格风险的住房与投资组合选择生命周期模型，我表明收入动态变化在很大程度上解释了代际间住房拥有率的下降。低收入家庭更难购买住房，因此积累的财富更少。（JEL D15, G51, J31, R21, R31）

articles.title_en: A Congestion Theory of Unemployment Fluctuations
articles.abstract_en: We propose a theory of unemployment fluctuations in which new hires and incumbent workers are imperfect substitutes. Hence, attempts to hire away the unemployed during recessions diminish the marginal product of new hires, discouraging job creation. This single feature achieves a tenfold increase in the volatility of hiring in an otherwise standard search model, produces a realistic Beveridge curve despite countercyclical separations, and explains 30–40 percent of US unemployment fluctuations. Additionally, it explains the excess procyclicality of new hires’ wages, the cyclical labor wedge, countercyclical earnings losses from job displacement, and the limited steady-state effects of unemployment insurance. (JEL E24, E32, J22, J23, J31, J63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种失业波动理论，其中新雇员和在职员工是不完全替代的。因此，在经济衰退期间试图挖走失业者的行为会降低新雇员的边际产出，从而抑制就业创造。这一单一特征在原本标准搜索模型中使招聘波动性增加了十倍，产生了尽管存在逆周期离职但仍具有现实性的贝弗里奇曲线，并解释了美国失业波动的30-40%。此外，它还解释了新雇员工资的过度顺周期性、周期性劳动楔子、失业人员因工作置换而产生的逆周期收入损失，以及失业保险的有限稳态效应。(JEL E24, E32, J22, J23, J31, J63)

articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of fiscal expansions on firm investment by exploiting firms with multiple banking relationships. Further, we conduct a localized approach and compare the lending behavior of banks that barely met and missed the criteria of being a primary dealer, as well as barely winners and losers at government auctions. Our results indicate that a 1 percentage point increase in primary dealer banks’ bonds-to-assets ratio decreases loans by 0.2 percent, which leads to declines in firm investment, profits, and wages. Our findings are grounded in a quantitative model with which we compute the cost of borrowing on the economy. (JEL D22, E12, E23, G21, G32, H63, O11)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过利用拥有多重银行关系的企业来研究财政扩张对企业投资的影响。此外，我们采用局部方法，比较了勉强达到和未达到一级交易商标准的银行，以及政府拍卖中勉强获胜和失败的银行的贷款行为。我们的结果表明，一级交易商银行的债券与资产比率增加1个百分点会使贷款减少0.2%，从而导致企业投资、利润和工资下降。我们的发现基于一个定量模型，我们通过该模型计算了借贷对经济的成本。（JEL D22, E12, E23, G21, G32, H63, O11）

articles.abstract_en: We show that prior lifetime experiences can “scar” consumers. Consumers who have lived through times of unemployment exhibit persistent pessimism about their future financial situation and spend significantly less years later, controlling for income, employment, and other life-cycle consumption factors. Due to their experience-induced frugality, scarred consumers build up more wealth. We use a stochastic life-cycle model to show that financial constraints and traditional models of income and unemployment scarring fail to generate the negative relationship between past experiences and consumption. Instead, the relationship is consistent with experience-based learning. (JEL D12, D15, D91, E21, E24, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，先前的终身经历可以“伤害”消费者。经历过失业时期的消费者对未来财务状况表现出持续的悲观情绪，并在多年后显著减少支出，同时控制收入、就业和其他生命周期消费因素。由于经历引发的节俭，受伤害的消费者积累了更多财富。我们使用随机生命周期模型表明，金融约束和传统的收入与失业伤害模型无法产生过去经历与消费之间的负向关系。相反，这种关系与基于经历的学习一致。（JEL D12, D15, D91, E21, E24, G51）

articles.title_en: Firms’ Precautionary Savings and Employment during a Credit Crisis
articles.title_cn: 信贷危机期间企业的预防性储蓄与就业
articles.abstract_en: Can the macroeconomic effects of credit supply shocks be large even when a small share of firms is credit constrained? I use UK firm-level accounting data to discipline a heterogeneous-firm model where the interaction between real and financial frictions induces precautionary cash holdings. In the data, firms increased their cash ratios during the Great Recession, and cash-intensive firms displayed higher employment growth. A tightening of firms’ credit conditions generates the same dynamics in the model. Unconstrained firms preemptively respond to credit supply shocks; this precautionary channel, when appropriately quantified, crucially matters for the aggregate dynamics and firm-level patterns. (JEL D22, E24, E32, E44, G32)
articles.abstract_cn: 即使只有一小部分企业受到信贷约束，信贷供给冲击的宏观经济效应也可能很大吗？我使用英国企业层面的会计数据来约束一个异质性企业模型，在该模型中，实际摩擦与金融摩擦之间的相互作用引发了预防性现金持有。在数据中，企业在大衰退期间提高了现金比率，而现金密集型企业表现出更高的就业增长。企业信贷条件的收紧在模型中产生了相同的动态。不受约束的企业对信贷供给冲击做出预防性反应；当适当量化时，这一预防性渠道对总体动态和企业层面模式至关重要。（JEL D22, E24, E32, E44, G32）

articles.title_en: Assessing the Stabilizing Effects of Unemployment Benefit Extensions
articles.title_cn: 评估失业救济金延期的稳定效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the stabilizing role of benefit extensions. We develop a tractable quantitative model with heterogeneous agents, search frictions, and nominal rigidities. The model allows for a stabilizing aggregate demand channel and a destabilizing labor market channel. We characterize each channel analytically and find that aggregate demand effects quantitatively prevail in the United States. When feeding in estimated shocks, the model tracks unemployment in the two most recent downturns. We find that extensions lowered unemployment by a maximum of 0.36 pp in the Great Recession, while the joint stabilizing effect of extensions and benefit compensation peaked at 1.12 pp in the pandemic. (JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究救济金延期的稳定作用。我们构建了一个包含异质性主体、搜索摩擦和名义刚性的可处理定量模型。该模型允许存在稳定的总需求渠道和不稳定的劳动力市场渠道。我们对每个渠道进行了分析性刻画，并发现总需求效应在美国定量上占主导地位。在输入估计的冲击时，该模型追踪了最近两次衰退中的失业情况。我们发现，延期在大衰退期间最多将失业率降低了0.36个百分点，而在疫情期间，延期和救济金补偿的联合稳定效应峰值达到1.12个百分点。(JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, J64, J65)

articles.title_en: Adverse Selection Dynamics in Privately Produced Safe Debt Markets
articles.title_cn: 私人生产的安全债务市场中的逆向选择动态
articles.abstract_en: Privately produced safe debt is designed so that there is no adverse selection in trade. But in some macro states—here, the onset of the pandemic—it becomes profitable for some agents to produce private information, and then agents face adverse selection when they trade the debt (i.e., it becomes information sensitive). We empirically study these adverse selection dynamics in a very important asset class, collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), which finance loans to below-investment-grade firms. We decompose the bid-ask spreads on the AAA bonds of CLOs into a component reflecting dealer bank balance sheet costs and the adverse selection component. (JEL D22, D82, E44, G12, G14, G32)
articles.abstract_cn: 私人生产的安全债务被设计为在交易中不存在逆向选择。但在某些宏观状态下——这里指疫情爆发时——一些代理人生产私人信息变得有利可图，然后代理人在交易债务时面临逆向选择（即债务变得信息敏感）。我们在一个非常重要的资产类别——抵押贷款债务（CLOs）中实证研究了这些逆向选择动态，该资产类别为低于投资级别的公司提供贷款融资。我们将CLO的AAA级债券的买卖价差分解为反映交易商银行资产负债表成本的组成部分和逆向选择组成部分。（JEL D22, D82, E44, G12, G14, G32）
